coupling_convention: g_phigammagamma in GeV^-1, derived from lifetime limit via paper's Eq.(11) with q=2
notes: Paper derives new 2-sigma exclusion limits on DM decay lifetime (qGamma)^-1 from 285 ks XRISM/Resolve observations of the Centaurus cluster (double narrow-line analysis, Fig. 3 left), recast into ALP-photon coupling g_phigammagamma vs m_phi in Fig. 4 (left panel, ~4-16 keV, y-axis ~1e-18 to 1e-16 GeV^-1). Exact limit curve values are only in figures; the sole explicit numerical text value is 1/(qGamma) ~ 4.7e19 yr at m ~ 4.6 keV (Fig. 2 caption). Data points here were computed from that lifetime value using the paper's ALP lifetime formula Gamma^-1 = 4.2e24 yr (1e-18 GeV^-1/g)^2 (keV/m)^3 with q=2, assuming an approximately mass-independent lifetime limit ~4.7e19 yr across the band; actual figure curve fluctuates, so values are approximate (factor ~2 uncertainty). NFW profiles assumed for Centaurus cluster (rho_s=0.025 GeV/cm^3) and Milky Way (rho_s=0.46 GeV/cm^3); this is a decay-line indirect-detection search, not a haloscope, so no local DM density field set. Paper also presents sterile-neutrino sin^2(2theta) recast and single-peak lifetime limits not encoded here. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 5))
